text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Pant... Huff... Oh...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I did it! I ran the entire 2,400 meters! I really did it... Wheeze...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Thank you... so much!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ngh... Urgh...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the race, Nishino Flower is so
exhausted she
can't move, let alone
bask in her victory.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I'm fine... Sorry... I just need... to
rest a little
longer...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's completely wiped out. She must've
pushed
past her limits and used every
last drop in the
tank to achieve today's
win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If we continue as planned, her next race
is the
Shuka Sho, another
medium-distance race.
However, seeing
how tired she is, I can't help but
worry.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I was watching you run from up here.
You were so
wonderfully fast, just like a
cutting gale.
choice_data_list: （これ以上進むのは厳しい。むしろ――）

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes. And when that blossom finally
blooms, we
will face each other on the
track.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's right. Nishino Flower has a secret
weapon,
and I know just the type of race
she can best use
it in.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. Sorry for the wait. I feel a bit
better now.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...
Yes, thank you.
choice_data_list: まずは本当におめでとう！

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Yes?
choice_data_list: それで、次のレースなんだけど……

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Does that mean...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: You think... I can't keep going?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's no denying she achieved
something great
today. With some
further adjustments, running in
the
Shuka Sho would be a viable option.

However...
choice_data_list: 絶対に無理だとは思ってないよ

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Shine even brighter? What do you
mean?
choice_data_list: もっと輝ける舞台があるはず

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
choice_data_list: この先は短距離で挑戦していかないか
この先は短距離で挑戦していかない？

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...It's actually a relief to hear that.
Honestly, I
already knew things might
come to this.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
The Japanese Oaks is a big race, so I
wanted to
try my best for it...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
But it was a little too much for me, and
there were
times when things felt
incredibly tough...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... Thank you too.
choice_data_list: 頑張ってくれてありがとう

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure I can perform even better in
sprints, so
let's do it!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
So... what should we set as my goal?
Considering
the season, should we aim
for a graded race in
the summer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her reasoning is sound. Running in one
of the
many summer races of the Sprint
tour is a good
way to acclimatize. But
she can aim even bigger!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh?! But isn't that a G1 race?!
choice_data_list: 『スプリンターズステークス』はどうかな

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
You want me to run that right after
changing
course? Not to mention there'll
be senior-year
racers participating...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This will be Nishino Flower's first time
running in a
race with older competitors.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Compared to them, I'm still just a kid,
aren't I?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Will I even stand a chance?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's always been self-conscious of how
she's
younger than her peers, so I
understand why she's
worried about
running against her upperclassmen.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Not as I am right now...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The academy's summer camp will be
starting
soon, a time during which racers
tend to make
vast improvements.
choice_data_list: 夏でもっと成長できる

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: 俺も頑張るから、一緒に強くなろう！
私も頑張るから、一緒に強くなろう！

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Okay. Then I'll follow your lead!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, we decide to make our next
goal the G1
sprint, the Sprinters Stakes.
